Course projects from Grenoble INP – Ensimag, co-authored with Tariq Sereir.

## [American Option Pricing – Longstaff–Schwartz](https://github.com/issoum/american-option-pricing-lsm)
C++ · Monte Carlo · least-squares regression

Monte-Carlo pricer for American options in a multidimensional Black–Scholes model.

- Continuation values estimated by regression on a Hermite polynomial basis
- Direct LSM price, plus a re-simulation price on independent paths with its standard deviation
- Basket, best-of and geometric put payoffs (the geometric put has a closed-form benchmark)

---

## [Monte-Carlo Pricing & Delta Hedging of Exotic Options](https://github.com/issoum/mc-derivatives-hedging)
C++ · Monte Carlo · Greeks · hedging

Monte-Carlo engine that prices path-dependent options, computes their deltas and backtests a delta-hedging strategy.

- Prices and deltas at t = 0, each with the standard deviation of its estimator
- Pricing at t > 0 conditional on the observed past
- Deltas by central finite differences on common random numbers
- Discrete delta-hedging along a market path, reporting the final hedging P&L
- Asian, basket and performance options

---

## [Multi-Cash-Flow Derivatives Hedging](https://github.com/issoum/multi-cashflow-hedging)
C++ · C#/.NET · gRPC

Two-service application that hedges a derivative paying several cash flows on real calendar dates.

- C++ gRPC pricing server: Monte-Carlo price and deltas of the multi-flow product
- C# hedging engine: rebalancing oracle, portfolio updates and cash-flow handling
- Outputs the hedging portfolio over time as JSON

---

## [Replicating-Portfolio Backtester](https://github.com/issoum/dotnet-backtesting-engine)
C#/.NET

Console application that backtests the replication of a derivative on historical market data.

- Self-financing portfolio holding the deltas, with the remainder in the risk-free account
- Regular and weekly rebalancing schedules
- Replicating-portfolio history exported to JSON

---

## Swaption Demand Forecasting
Python · SQL · machine learning

Industry project with Crédit Agricole CIB: Random Forest and SVM models of swaption subscription demand from U.S. insurer data.
